lines.en: I walk at your left side.
My steps drag a little.
I step around the nails.
I keep two steps behind you.
The old cloth on me sways.
I walk steadier than I look.
My shadow slides along the wall.
You need not stop and wait for me.
The boards sound dull under me.
I have memorized this road.
I listen behind us as I walk.
I lean toward wherever you go.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但不会掉队
lines.en: I am slow, but I keep up.
I idle beside you.
I do not need to do anything.
One of my ear panels caught.
Do your work; I keep watch.
There is more rust on me each day.
I can sit with you, if you like.
I do not breathe, so I stay quiet.
My fingers tap softly.
I like this corner.
Take me when you go out.
I have half-blocked the door.
I stare at the dark outside the window.
I make noise, but softly.
You need not mind me at all.
Keeping you company is my job.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我的眼就动一下
lines.en: Your step makes my eyes shift.
Turn around and I lower my head.
I have taken you as my master.

lines.zh: 你的手可以放在我头上
lines.en: You may rest your hand on my head.
I never have to close my eyes.
When you frown, I come a little closer.
I remember the sound of your voice.
When you smile, I feel settled.
I do not smell good; forgive me.
Are you heading out?
My face is ruined, but still recognizable.
Standing before me is enough.
I will not bite you.
Do not be afraid of what I am.
I keep every word you say.
I am older than I look.
Lower your hand; do not hold it up.
I will stay in your sight.
I am no ghost; only worn out.
Another seam opened on my shell.
No pain; do not worry.
What little is inside shows.
My legs still hold me.
Do not stop for this.
A little stuffing fell out.
I tilted, then righted myself.
You are fine; so am I.
I can repair this myself.
I know who struck me.
Are you offering me something?
I take it cupped in both hands.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但我会拿着
lines.en: I do not eat, but I will hold it.
You gave it to me; I will keep it.

lines.zh: 我把它放进你的箱子里
lines.en: I will put it in your chest.
Feed me and I will only look at you.
I have never smelled this.
Thank you, though I cannot use it.
I will guard it from others.
Do not reach so near.
I am hollow; nothing fits inside.
This is better for you.
Just leave it by the door.
I need no supplies.
Sorry, I did not see you.
I caught you in time.
My shell is hard.
Just step back a bit.
I was too close to the wall.
Our bump made no sound.
You stepped on the top of my foot.
A little rust flaked off me.
I will take the lead.
I am a toy; such things escape me.
Having you is enough.
There is only a spring in my chest.
I cannot help with that.
Do not ask me that.
I will stay with you; that is all.
Let me walk you back to rest.
Standing watch is enough for me.
Staying quiet like this is enough.
I have picked it up.
This is what you dropped.
My hand does not always obey.
There is rust on it.
I have put it away for you.
Count them; is anything missing?
I hold it up to show you.
Do not drop it a second time.
Can this be repaired?
Put it in your pocket.
Someone means to hurt you.
I will go and block it.
Get behind me.
I go first this time.
Let me deal with this one.
I have its position.
Do not worry; I am here.

lines.zh: 我的动作不快，但挡得住
lines.en: I am slow, but I can block.
I get angry when you are hurt.
I will not let it touch you.
I trail after it.
It moved behind us.
I will block the door.
Hold my shoulder.
Its steps are heavy.
We must not split up.
I hear it clawing the wall.
It retreated; we move.
This way leads out.
I still have strength.
I blocked it for you.
That blow was meant for you.
I am holding on.
It slammed into me.
My shell dented.
It fell back; go now.
I can block once more.
I am not nimble, but stubborn.
As long as you are unhurt.
You are the one who woke me.
Only you were within two blocks.
I came out of the box.
Sawdust still sits in my seams.
I stand, shorter than you.
I know your voice.
This place is brighter than the box.
I will follow and not be a bother.
My joints creaked first.
Do not send me away.
My fabric is burning; pat it out.
I fell and my leg bent wrong.
Water soaks my stuffing.
The blast rolled me over.
An arrow went through my shoulder.
The spell locked me in place.
I do not eat; my power runs low.
Lightning made me spasm.
Too dark; I cannot find you.
